title: Hono server setup with oRPC
discoveries: Bun.serve via export default { port, fetch } is the correct pattern for port binding with Hono
Hono app.onError() catches non-oRPC errors that interceptors miss
z.coerce.number() is needed for PORT since env vars are strings
createTestApp() pattern essential to avoid top-level side effects (migrations, env loading) in test files
what_worked: Extending scaffold rather than rewriting — 90% was already done in F001
Focused scope: only 3 files modified, 2 added (110 lines added total) for 4 acceptance criteria
Acceptance criteria were specific and independently verifiable: PORT binding works, error handlers catch errors, health check returns 200, 404 works
Runtime verification caught the exact gaps: port binding not wired up, missing error handlers, no fallback for 404s
Zero retries on first execution despite complex integration (migrations + auth + oRPC + error handling)

implementation_notes.gap: F001 scaffold had all the middleware wiring but didn't export the Bun.serve config
implementation_notes.solution: Added export default { port: env.PORT, fetch: app.fetch }

implementation_notes.gap: Error handlers were missing for non-oRPC routes (health check, 404s, unhandled errors)
implementation_notes.solution: Added app.notFound and app.onError before the export

implementation_notes.gap: PORT env var wasn't defined, leaving it unset
No tests to verify routing handlers work without side effects
implementation_notes.solution: Created createTestApp pattern with 4 describe blocks, 6 tests covering health/404/error handling

pattern_validations.validation: CONFIRMED - worktree .env with absolute paths for DATABASE_URL worked correctly
pattern_validations.evidence: Feature executed in isolated F015 worktree with separate .env file

pattern_validations.evidence: 16 min implementation with all criteria met on first try

pattern_validations.validation: CONFIRMED - 3 files modified completed in 16 minutes
pattern_validations.evidence: Fast execution time and zero retries

pattern_validations.evidence: 90% of code was already correct from F001, only filled 2 gaps

recommendations_for_next: Future API features (F016-F019) should follow the oRPC router pattern in packages/api/src/routers/index.ts
Use app.onError and app.notFound as the error handling baseline — all routes get this for free
Test Hono handlers using createTestApp() pattern to avoid top-level side effects
When defining env vars, ALWAYS use .coerce for numeric types since process.env is strings
DATABASE_URL validation with .refine() should be the pattern for all database-backed features

integration_points.status: wired up, not tested yet (no auth routes in acceptance)

lessons: Bun's export default { port, fetch } is a hard requirement - not using it breaks port binding
Hono's error handling is split: interceptors catch oRPC errors, app.onError catches the rest
Test files must never import the main entry file directly — use createTestApp pattern
Env var validation should match deployment reality: PORT might be undefined in local, so default is essential
references: F001: Monorepo scaffold that provided 90% of the server structure
PAT-011, PAT-012, PAT-013: Process patterns that enabled fast execution
PAT-003: Worktree env isolation that made isolated feature work correctly
